outside.reason: Outdoor coverage: retain medium-confidence returns; reject isolated depth spikes without flattening slopes.

lobby.reason: Interior reflective boundaries: remove uncertain depth discontinuities, retain RGB colors and real floor heights.

bridge_out1f.reason: Lighting transition and sparse overlap: preserve coverage rather than impose an indoor plane or aggressive confidence gate.

floor2.reason: Repeated corridor walls: suppress isolated/boundary depth artifacts; do not fuse distinct repeated structures or flatten floors/stairs.

bridge_12_sub.reason: Stair treads and risers: no depth smoothing, no edge erosion, no global floor height.
